entities.name: gatekeeper seated on a box seat by the fence
entities.what: The gatekeeper (门房), a bearded man in a plain light robe, hair tied up, no hat, sits on a low box seat in front of the fence's east end, just west of the gate's post. He faces east with his head tilted back and his mouth open. His hands are raised before his chest, as if he is talking up to the man leaning at the post.
entities.vis: part: feet hidden in front of the seat (not drawn)
entities.src: 余辉: 门房指路 (问道); 名画记: 官宦人家 (pin 49, u 1240)
entities.note: Seated on S7.prop.seat_box_gatekeeper_1070 (front u 1037-1102, v 885-933). Knees at u 1075-1102, v 860-880. Foot est at the seat's front foot under his knees. Painted height 136 px seated (head 798 to v 934). The fence's east end post (cap at (1101, 797)) stands just east of his face, so it is not a staff in his hand. The restyle reads him correctly (red robe, box seat).

entities.name: man leaning at the gate's west post
entities.what: A man in a light robe, hair in a small topknot, stands behind the seated gatekeeper and leans back against the gate's west post and the stone block. His head turns down-left toward the gatekeeper, and one arm reaches down toward him, or to the fence post. He is a servant or second doorman of the compound.
entities.vis: part: lower body behind the gatekeeper and the fence post
entities.note: Head u 1125-1142, v 750-775. Body down the post at u 1120-1145, v 775-857. The legs run down to an angled foot at u 1105-1130, v 905-920, just west of the stone block (block front u 1130-1190, foot v 899). Painted height 164 px, a standing adult's (the visitor's is 165), so he stands rather than sits. The restyle paints him in white, sitting back against the block with one leg forward.

entities.name: visitor with a cloth bundle and a food box
entities.what: A visitor (traveller or messenger) in a long dark-grey jacket belted over light trousers, with dark hair or a soft dark cap. A big cloth bundle tied at his neck hangs down his back and left side. In his right hand he carries a small square food box (食盒) by its handle. Seen from behind, he has stopped before the gate and turns to the man in the dark cap, who points him the way.
entities.src: 余辉: 门房指路 (问道); 名画记: 官宦人家 (pin 49)
entities.note: Feet at (1291, 972) and (1326, 974). Painted height 165 px. Bundle u 1245-1295, v 838-920. Food box u 1313-1340, v 904-942, handle top at v 904. Both are carried things, part of the figure. The brief's foot (1290, 965) is his left foot.

entities.name: man in a dark cap pointing the way
entities.what: A man in a dark cap (a black futou-like hat) and a light robe with a sash stands in the gate's east bay beside the free-standing boards. He faces the visitor and points west with his right hand, giving directions. A tied sack stands in front of him, against the gate's east block S7.str.gate_block_east_1345.
entities.vis: part: legs hidden behind the tied sack S7.prop.tied_sack_1365
entities.src: 余辉: 门房指路 (问道)
entities.note: Cap u 1354-1380, v 761-778. Pointing hand at about (1326, 828), arm at v 825-835; sash at v ≈ 848. Foot est just behind (north of) the sack's foot (v 945). Painted height about 179 px with the cap. The restyle gives him a woman's hair bun and adds a white puff at about (1330, 745). The scan has neither: it shows a dark cap and plain silk.

entities.name: small head peeking at the gate's open door leaf (low)
entities.what: A small head with dark hair and a pale face shows at the edge of the open door leaf inside the gate, as if a servant or a child peeks out. No body is drawn below it, and it may be a small lamp or ornament hung on the door rather than a person.
entities.vis: part: only the head; body hidden behind the door leaf
entities.note: Head u 1245-1257, v 675-692: 12 x 17 px, about half the size of the adults' heads at the gate, so a child or a figure far back. The light door leaf spans u 1207-1260, with a knocker dot at (1228, 727). Foot est on the gate hall's floor line where the leaf ends (v ≈ 797); the hall floor may be raised (structures agent). Readings: (a) a head peeking round the door (servant or child); (b) a small lamp hung inside the gate (the setup agent's first reading; the restyle paints a small ochre object with a dark top), which would be part of the gatehouse. MERGE: the structures pass read the same shape as a small lamp hanging inside the gate (S7.bld.gatehouse_1240, point head_or_lamp_w (1248,682)); it is one thing, to be built once, as this head or as that lamp. On a zoom-8 crop no cord or hook runs from the lintel (v 650) to it; the vertical line just east of it (u ~1257) is the door leaf's edge. The structures pass found no raised floor or step in the gate hall, so the support stays ground.

entities.name: low box seat of the gatekeeper
entities.what: A plain low box or block about 65 px wide and 48 px tall in front, standing before the fence's east end. The gatekeeper sits on it.
entities.vis: part: top covered by the seated gatekeeper
entities.note: Front face u 1037-1102, v 885-933. Seen square-on; no side face is drawn. SCALE: front 65 x 48 px. The restyle paints a wooden box stool.

entities.name: tied cloth sack set down at the gate
entities.what: A big pale cloth sack, its neck tied with cords, stands on the ground in front of the pointing man; it may instead be held by its neck.
entities.note: Sack u 1343-1385, v 867-947; the tied neck is at about (1355-1362, 868-875) with cords hanging. It is read as a separate sack, not the man's lower robe: his sash is at v ≈ 848, and the shape narrows to a knot below it before bulging out. The restyle also paints a white sack. The strokes do not show whose it is (the visitor's luggage or the pointing man's). SCALE: 42 x 80 px.

entities.name: porter with shoulder-pole baskets
entities.what: A porter in a wide dark hat with an upturned brim, a dark short jacket belted at the waist and light trousers strides along the street toward the viewer. A carrying pole lies across his shoulders, with a round basket hung from each end on three cords: the west one filled with straw-like hatching, the east one with crossed strokes (produce or goods).
entities.note: His west foot is lifted with the sole showing at (1220, 1235-1244); his east foot is planted at (1291, 1235). The foot point is midway between them. Painted height 171 px. Pole from u ≈ 1160 to 1365 at v ≈ 1093-1100. West basket u 1155-1211, body v 1163-1201 (cords from v 1104). East basket u 1295-1364, body v 1145-1213. The curled dark shape at (1350-1368, 1147-1167) just past the east basket is the ridge-end ornament of the small roof on posts (structures), not part of his load.

entities.name: old willow at the cut edge
entities.what: A big old willow at the scroll's cut end. Its gnarled, lumpy trunk rises behind the fence's west end, knotted where its limbs spring, and a tall stem runs up off the top of the silk. Long hanging whips (early spring, no leaves drawn) fill the whole top-left corner, and a long limb arches east over the gatehouse roofs with whips hanging to v ≈ 600.
entities.vis: part: collector's seal over the lower trunk and the foot; crown runs off the silk's top and west edge
entities.src: sections.md S7: the willows and the cut edge
entities.note: Trunk: a knotted section at u 880-930, v 560-720, outside the seals; the upper stem at u 920-945, v 250-550 continues up off the silk at u ≈ 900-915. Below v 720 the trunk lies under the lower seal (red, u 815-905, v 600-960). There only a dark ink band shows, at u 839-863, v 672-845, plus a dark mark at (835-847, 885-890). The base is estimated there on the ground line: the fence's foot is at v ≈ 880, and root or ground strokes run east at u 920-970, v 880-897. The seal's straight east border at u ≈ 899 is not a trunk. The restyle paints a second trunk there (u 895-910) and trunk feet at v 870-880, but the scan has one trunk only. The long east limb springs from the stem at (930, 360) and arcs over (1000, 335) to (1100, 315), with a second arc at v 315-335. Its whips hang over u 960-1232, down to the fence top at u 940-1000 (v ≈ 790) and to v ≈ 600 over the gatehouse roof. This limb is the brief's 'one more willow crown at u 980-1150'. No second trunk shows between u 960 and 1060 down to the fence, so the crown is read as part of this tree; if a second trunk stood hidden behind the gatehouse, it is not painted.

entities.name: bare tree with knobbed twigs at the street's south-west edge
entities.what: A bare, gnarled tree with no leaves (elm- or willow-like) at the street's south-west edge. Its thick, dark, speckled trunk leans a little west. Crooked limbs end in knobbed twig tips and spread over the west end of the street, from the cut edge to u ≈ 1195. A spray of long fine shoots sweeps east from its lower trunk over u 980-1265.
entities.vis: part: trunk foot hidden among its own shoots and the twigs of S7.tree.bare_bottom_1117
entities.note: Trunk seen at u 915-962, v 1060-1230, then running down-left to (885-925, 1320), where it is lost. The base is estimated there, just south of the street's south-edge line (v ≈ 1288). Knobbed twig tips: the top at (950, 932), just below the fence's foot; east tips at (1185-1195, 1010-1060); west limbs run to the seal at the cut edge (v 912-1090). The fine shoots radiate from the lower trunk at about (900-985, 1236-1320) to u 1265, v 1150-1290. A dark twisted limb with dark buds runs down-left from (900, 1250) to the cut edge at v ≈ 1310-1420. It is either this tree's limb (then the foot may lie beyond the cut) or part of S7.tree.gnarled_low_edge_875. The restyle runs this tree's trunk off the west edge at v ≈ 1400.

entities.name: low gnarled tree with dark buds at the cut edge (low)
entities.what: A dark, blotchy, gnarled form at the bottom-left of the silk: a knotted low trunk or stump with dark moss-like dots, whose crooked limbs, set with dark buds, rise along the cut edge to v ≈ 1165.
entities.vis: part: limbs run off the silk's west edge; foot among the bottom shoots
entities.note: Dark blotches ('trunk') at u 842-930, v 1467-1610; dotted crooked limbs at u 815-900, v 1160-1445. Readings: (a) a small old tree of its own: the restyle paints a gnarled trunk at u 840-900, v 1490-1650 and a plum-like tree with buds at u 816-880, v 1250-1550; (b) a rock with moss dots at the foot of S7.tree.bare_knobbed_905, whose down-left limb carries the dotted twigs. Base est under the blotches.

entities.name: big bare tree along the bottom edge
entities.what: A big bare tree south of the street, with no leaves and dense fine twigs. A straight trunk rises from below the silk's bottom edge and forks at v ≈ 1506 into many limbs fanning west and east. Long low limbs arch east to u ≈ 1440, and the fine twig tips form a broad dome whose top touches the street's south edge.
entities.vis: part: trunk foot below the silk's bottom edge
entities.note: Trunk at u 1108-1125 from the bottom edge (v ≈ 1768) up to the fork at (1115, 1506). It is the only trunk visible in u 815-1450 below v 1450; the restyle merges all the bottom trees into this one. Its low limbs spring near the bottom edge at u 1130-1170 and arch east over u 1170-1440 (v 1550-1760). Twig tips with dots line v ≈ 1283-1300 at u 1100-1200. The upright shoot masses beside it are separate entities: S7.tree.shoots_bottom_west_960, and a second clump to the east at u 1400-1560 (foot ≈ (1480, 1770), t2's range).

entities.name: mass of upright bare shoots along the bottom edge (west)
entities.what: A dense, dome-topped mass of fine upright bare shoots rises from below the silk's bottom edge west of the big bare tree. These are the crowns of low trees or the young shoots of a pollarded willow; their trunks are not painted.
entities.vis: part: foot below the silk's bottom edge
entities.note: The shoots converge downward toward the bottom edge near u ≈ 890 and u ≈ 1070, perhaps two clumps. No trunk is drawn, so the mass is recorded once. It could also be the low twigs of S7.tree.bare_bottom_1117. The restyle paints willow masses here. The silk's bottom edge is at v ≈ 1761-1770 in u 815-1460.

entities.name: 门房指路: the gatekeeper's men give a visitor directions
entities.what: At the gate of the official's compound (官宦人家), the gatekeeper sits on a box seat by the fence, talking up to a man leaning at the gate post. Meanwhile a visitor with a cloth bundle and a food box has stopped before a man in a dark cap, who points him the way. A tied sack stands between them, against the gate's east block, and a small head may peek from behind the open door leaf.
entities.src: 余辉: 门房指路 (问道); 名画记: 官宦人家 (pin 49, u 1240)
entities.note: Four painted men (one more, the small head, is conf low). The gatehouse with its stone block, the fence and the hanging object in the gate's east bay are the structures agent's; 赵太丞家's free-standing boards just east of the pointing man are t2's.

entities.name: low dark stones at the railing's foot (low)
entities.what: A low, dark, irregular mass on the ground at the foot of the railing west of the gate, just east of its west post: a few low stones (the restyle paints rocks), or the edge willow's root flare running east from its trunk under the seal.
entities.note: Dark wash with a small peak at about (945,883), u ~915-970, v 880-897 (merge, zoom 4): about 55 x 15 px (0.7 x 0.2 m). No head or legs are drawn, so it is not an animal. Readings: (a) low stones at the railing's foot; (b) the root flare of S7.tree.willow_edge_855 (base est (855,888), under the seal): then retire this and add it to the willow's note. Added in the merge: the structures pass and t1 each left it to the other.
